subject: LinuxTerminal.js: root session home should be /root, not /home/root
description: Discovered 2026-07-11 (Chris QC on ssh-keygen fix #66). LinuxTerminal.js models EVERY user's home as /home/${config.user} consistently across _initEnv().HOME (:164), _initCurrentUser().home (:191), _createBaseFilesystem (:95), and ~ expansion (state.currentUser.home, :1452). For a root session ~ resolves to /home/root, contradicting real Linux (/root). CONSEQUENCE: da-linux-post-exploitation.lab.html:45 seeds its authored key at literal /root/.ssh/id_rsa which ~/.ssh never resolves to. NOT a functional break today (that lab grades on command-text regex; phantom /home/root key doesn't affect grading). FIX is load-bearing, NOT a one-liner: making root home /root requires coordinating HOME env + base-fs seed + currentUser.home + the uid-0 quirk (_initCurrentUser().uid is hardcoded 1000 even for root, so _canRead's uid===0 root-superpower never fires). A naive `home: user==='root'?'/root':...` would BREAK root cd~/ls~ (home dir seeded at /home/root would be empty at /root). Needs its own Nancy review + multi-root-lab harness + re-verify da-lab seed path. Detail in marathon backlog.
